evidence.detail: The class owns a 104x104 int clipping grid. Reset marks the outer border with 0x00FFFFFF and interior cells with 0x01000000, matching a tile collision/clipping map rather than terrain heights or scene objects.

Wall placement/removal methods apply reciprocal directional masks to the target tile and its neighbor (including 1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128 and projectile-blocking counterparts such as 1024,4096,16384,65536).
Additional methods set/clear rectangular object-blocking masks and test whether one tile/area can reach another through directional clipping flags for wall/decor/object interaction.

candidates.note: CollisionMap is fixed by the exact tile-clipping grid, reciprocal directional wall masks and reachability tests; it is a semantic recovery name rather than an original-identifier claim.
